description.p: Codex Meter shows the usage limits of your coding agents at a glance: Codex 5-hour and weekly windows and banked resets, Claude Code's 5-hour, weekly and per-model limits, and Cursor's included usage and on-demand spend.

ul.li: A dashboard per provider with rings, reset times and pace estimates
Browser sign-in; credentials are encrypted with a key in your login keyring
A tray icon with your remaining allowance, and notifications for resets and low allowance
No analytics, no ads, no relay server

description.p: Codex Meter is unofficial and not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic or Anysphere.
